peerGroup.rule: same class (condo), market segment (CCR) and lease-age group; original lease 99 years or longer

positions.label: Price position
positions.statement: Price position — In line with comparable condos: 4.2% above its local comparables; 93 of 144 similar developments with a figure have a lower relative price (a position, not a measure of value).

positions.label: Resale activity
positions.statement: Resale activity — Above peers (97.9): 8.7 resales per 100 homes a year (24 months): higher than 396 of 405 similar developments with a figure (the same as 1). Context, not scored: resales in 25% of months (24 months).

comparisonGroup.rule: same class (condo), market segment (CCR) and lease-age group; original lease 99 years or longer

profile.rule: Each line compares this development with its own comparison group; numbers from different groups are not comparable. There is no overall score.
profile.surroundingMarket: Surrounding market: other condo and EC developments within 2 km (straight line between development positions); new sales plus resales; subsales, cluster and other landed housing, HDB flats and this development are excluded. Competition, the quiet-area check and the Market backdrop use this same set.

lines.label: Entry price against comparable developments
lines.statement: 2-bedroom: median $1,433,000 ($1,771 psf, 753–818 sq ft; 8 resales, Jun 2024–May 2026); 8 comparable developments within 3 km: median $1,700 psf (range $1,524–2,535); 4.2% above; illustrative entry-price difference about $57,000 more. The entry-price difference is illustrative: the median price adjusted to the comparable median psf, for a similar-size unit. A premium or a discount is not in itself an advantage or a disadvantage.

lines.label: Sustained resale activity
lines.statement: No first resale wave in the observation period: sustained activity is the observed activity.

lines.label: MRT today
lines.statement: Novena MRT about 730 m, Toa Payoh MRT about 900 m; closer than 45 of 551 similar developments (the same as 1). Straight-line distances.

lines.label: Primary schools
lines.statement: 2 within 1 km and 11 within 2 km; nearest ST. Joseph's Institution Junior about 910 m; more than 310 of 551 similar developments (the same as 182). Straight-line distances. MOE measures distance for school admission differently.

lines.label: Everyday amenities
lines.statement: 10 supermarkets within 1 km (nearest about 140 m), more than 462 of 551 similar developments (the same as 53); nearest hawker centre Whampoa Drive Makan Place/Whampoa Market about 470 m; nearest park Toa Payoh Town Park about 580 m. Straight-line distances.

lines.label: Future transport
lines.statement: Not yet assessed: needs official LTA evidence for planned stations.

lines.label: Recorded new-launch competition
lines.statement: 5 other condo developments sold new homes within 2 km (Sanctuary@Newton, 16 new sales, about 1,340 m; 32 Gilstead, 3 new sales, about 1,440 m; The Arcady at Boon Keng, 32 new sales, about 1,550 m; Piccadilly Grand, 1 new sales, about 1,560 m; The Orie, 25 new sales, about 1,680 m). Surrounding market, Oct 2025–Sep 2026: 295 other condo and EC developments within 2 km recorded 77 new sales and 797 resales (874 purchases); new sales were 8.8% of these purchases. Subsales (44) and this development’s own transactions are excluded. New sales as a share of local private purchases is a measure of market activity, not of supply pressure.

lines.label: Unsold inventory

missing.reason: not available until the URA-based launched-unsold measure (S3) passes the V1 local validation; no other inventory source is used

lines.statement: Not available: unsold inventory has not been validated.

lines.label: Known pipeline

missing.reason: known sites only; not a complete pipeline

lines.statement: Within 2 km: The Serra Residences (launch, launched, about 4 homes), about 290 m; Dorset Road GLS site (government land sale site, awarded), about 1,160 m; Bukit Timah Road GLS site (government land sale site, awarded), about 1,910 m. Known sites only; not a complete pipeline.

lines.label: Quiet-area check
lines.statement: Not a quiet area. 797 resales within 2 km in Oct 2025–Sep 2026, more than 166 of 551 similar developments.

lines.label: Market backdrop
lines.statement: Condo and EC resales within 2 km: 797 in Oct 2025–Sep 2026 against 854 in Oct 2024–Sep 2025 (−6.7%). Planning-area private resales −6.3%. Observed transactions, not a prediction.
